systems.system: système d'information de l'Agence nationale du registre des populations et des titres sécurisés
systems.owner: Agence nationale du registre des populations et des titres sécurisés (ANRPTS)
systems.tiers: central system behind the agency's digital services and the services of the centres d'accueil des citoyens; stopped for the whole of 8 August 2026 for preventive maintenance
mobile application for remote documents and identity verification for public and private services; about 1.5 million beneficiaries and 554,027 remote services
application grouping more than 15 public digital services, relying on Houwiyeti for identity verification

note: The document describes the ANRPTS system as a population-register and identity system and Houwiyeti as an identity and documents application; it does not say that births or deaths are registered in either, so the one-day maintenance stoppage of 8 August 2026 is given under systems and yields no civil fact.
